message.text:
h15.

Visibility is enforced independently on every surface that can expose a memo or something derived from one. The distinct sites:

h15.
`checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo read gate for `GetMemo`, parent-memo access, `ListMemoComments`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`, called at `:356`, `:367`, and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148`
`ListMemos` query-scoping for anonymous/other users (`VisibilityList = {Public, Protected}`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:225`
`CreateMemoComment` pre-comment check on the parent memo — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
Reaction service gates on `UpsertMemoReaction` / `DeleteMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30`, `:38`, `:83`
`ListMemoAttachments` gate — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214`, `:222`
Attachment service access check (attachment inherits its memo's visibility) — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445`, `:451`
User stats memo scoping — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:90`, `:220`
SSE broadcast filter `SSEClient.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`
File server `checkAttachmentPermission` (raw binary serving, plus share-token fallback) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677`, `:684`, `:699`
RSS feed scoping to public memos only — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90`, `:141`
Frontend/SSR memo fetch scoped to public only — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
Notification email content redaction by visibility — `server/notification/email.go:313`, `:316` and `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309`, `:312`
Mention-notification eligibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62`, `:67`, `:84`

Two structural notes. The sites split into two kinds: *post-fetch gates* that reject a specific memo (the `checkMemoReadAccess` family, reaction service, file server) and *query scoping* that never loads invisible rows in the first place (`ListMemos`, stats, RSS, frontend). The scoping form is what protects list endpoints, so there is no per-item check to find there.

The canonical policy lives in `checkMemoReadAccess` (`memo_service.go:39-68`): archived memos are visible only to their creator; non-public memos require authentication; private memos require being the creator. Other surfaces re-implement rather than reuse it, and they differ deliberately — the file server additionally accepts a valid, non-expired `share_token` for the specific memo (`fileserver.go:684-689`) and treats admins as permitted (`:699`), whereas `checkMemoReadAccess` grants no admin bypass for private memos. `server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:137` is the related share-token redemption path.
